{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_count = df['revenue'].isna().sum()

# Filter for completed orders and compute mean revenue
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

non_numeric_count, mean_revenue_completed"}
